caption: The drawing features a large central geometric star composed of red and green triangles arranged to form a symmetrical pattern. The points of the star alternate between red and green, with intricate triangular detailing along the edges of each point, made from small white triangles on a contrasting colored background. The star is set against a light, uncolored background with faintly sketched circular and linear quilting designs visible inside the squares surrounding the star. A border pattern surrounds the central motif, consisting of green triangles along the bottom and right edges, and a curved, wave-like design in the outermost border, also sketched in pencil without color. The composition is clearly outlined with straight and curved lines, and the only colors used are red and green with areas left white for contrast.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
